_README: TWO-FILES-ONE-QUANTITY std-PAT campaign, 2026-08-10 (runbook §70/§71 method applied to npStd vs sf_revop patS idx4).
Fresh scan vs origin/main found 46 disagreements (> max(0.02, 0.5%)), not the 35 in the stale sweep list.
EVERY verdict below is document-based: filer's own XBRL (scripts/_xbrl_cache or freshly fetched from the NSE list),
BSE detres (§42, quarter + all FY siblings + .50 audited annual), or the announcement PDF (§58 column anchor).
fund_fix = sf_fundamentals npStd was wrong (25 scan cells + 3 companions); mirror_fix = sf_revop patS was wrong (21+1).
Defect classes: H1/H2/FY-cumulative-as-quarter in fund (13); wrong-year/wrong-period OneD declarations poisoning the
mirror re-parse (KOHINOOR/SURAJEST/SIEMENS-class, 3); NSE double-indexed next-quarter filings poisoning the mirror at
Mar-2019 (6); revised-filing splits (4: RUBYMILLS/HOMEFIRST arithmetic-error corrections -> take revision;
MADRASFERT/VIJSHAN genuine restatements -> point-in-time first filing stays, §2d TRU precedent); XBRL sign-flip vs
own EPS row (SGFL ×3); blank-template zero (METROPOLIS); ×10 scale (ASTRAZEN); junk series (WORTH ×3);
WRONG COMPANY (KALYANI = Kalyani Commercials INE610E01010, but bse_scrips maps KALYANI->544023, a different company
whose FY25 detres annual 14.245 == our stored 8.01+6.23 exactly).
Revision rule used: a correction of an arithmetic error (original contradicts its own YTD/EPS) adopts the corrected
figure; a genuine restatement (original internally consistent) stays point-in-time on the first filing.

POST-PUSH ADDENDUM: the live re-verify exposed a companion class my first batch missed - for a no-sub filer the con slot carries the con=std identity, and update_fundamentals is fill-only, so a std CORRECTION never propagates: ASTRAZEN/HOMEFIRST/VENKEYS con still held the refuted std. Healed (con only in fund; patC deliberately NOT created where the mirror had none - every other quarter of a no-sub filer has patC null and inventing one would make the healed quarter the only cell asserting a consolidated figure no filing prints).
